title: Re-review Phase 2A Verdict-record Artifact
description: Phase 2A (persuasion-blind) evidence-verdict artifact of the #576 Spec B three-gate re-review contract. Committed BEFORE the Response to Reviewers is revealed; immutable once emitted ([EVIDENCE-COMMITTED]) — Phase 2B differences ride typed AdjustmentRecords in the §5.3 traceability sidecar, and the new_issues set FREEZES here whole-record (§13 byte-equality witness). Hash-bound to the Phase 1 artifact via precommitment_hash. Spec: docs/design/2026-07-27-576-spec-b-re-review-precommitment-contract-spec.md §5.2.

precommitment_hash.description: sha256 hex over the Phase 1 pre-commitment artifact's JSON Canonical Form (RFC 8785 / JCS). Second link of the §11 hash chain; the checker recomputes it.

items.description: Exactly one record per roadmap item, ALL priorities — the all-rows G1 guard needs a 2A-side witness on every row (§13).

new_issues.description: Issues found while reading the revised manuscript that are not traceable to a roadmap item (§8). This SET — every record, WHOLE-RECORD — freezes at [EVIDENCE-COMMITTED]; §5.3 carries the frozen copy.

dissents.description: Phase 2A discoveries that a pre-committed operationalization cannot be applied as written (§7). A criterion swap, visible, before the verdict — never a verdict-relaxation channel.

escalation_exceptions.description: §6.4 escalation exceptions, emitted at 2A with approval_state pending; approval happens only in §5.3 escalation_approvals.

verifier_seat.description: The DA seat is never a verification persona (§10).

residual_magnitude.description: Re-grading of what remains; feeds the §6 decision derivation (B4/B5).

evidence_anchor.description: Typed anchor(s) into the REVISED manuscript. Required for every verdict except CANNOT_VERIFY.

cannot_verify_reason.description: Required iff verdict = CANNOT_VERIFY (e.g. evidence surface inaccessible, criterion requires an artifact not in the input set).

change_summary.description: What actually changed relative to the original manuscript (from diff/apply report + comparison), one sentence. Stays total on the degraded no-original path with the §11 [CHANGE-BASIS-ABSENT] marker.

applied_criterion.description: not_precommitted is valid ONLY for priority consider items (no Phase-1 record exists, §3.2); a P1/P2 item carrying it fails the checker.

found_by.description: The discovering verifier's seat label — new issues are item-untraceable so no item-side verified_by exists (§8).

attribution.description: Only regression can move the decision (§6 goalpost guard); indeterminate is never silently promoted (SD-9).

nearest_roadmap_item.description: Typed non-match witness: the closest roadmap item, or null when nothing is even adjacent (§8).

criterion_hash.description: sha256 hex over the referenced Phase-1 PrecommitmentRecord's JSON Canonical Form (v3.6.3 convention). §13 RECOMPUTES it against the record — a stale or arbitrary value fails.

new_standard_ref.description: Optional pointer back to the Phase-1 NewStandardRecord that requested escalation. 2A may also emit an exception with no Phase-1 request (§5.1).

evidence_anchor.description: ORIGINAL-manuscript-side anchor — proving the issue existed in Round 1; revision-introduced content is a regression instead (§6.4).

mechanical_decision_impact.description: Step-3 floor; Reject is not a Stage 3' decision (§6.4).

approval_state.description: Literal emission constant — approval happens only in §5.3 escalation_approvals; DecisionInputs joins effective_approval_state from there and never copies this field.
